releases.displayName: Shard Squad's 1st Anniversary: Major Update, New DLC & New Game Reveal!

items.text: Today we're celebrating our first anniversary of Shard Squad's launch!

Thank you so much to everyone who faced hundreds of enemies and saved the lands of Mellunia from the terrors of the Desolument! As a thank you, we've prepared an update packed full of content that will let you experience Shard Squad in a completely new way!
New DLC: Ice Character Pack
Four new characters of the Ice element can join your squad!
Wendy - freeze everything around you with glacial rays
Glassaim - launch ice stakes to shatter enemies from a distance
Klaugus V - crush with his sack of gifts
Yukina - envelop enemies with her lingering blizzard
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45317685/2e5dd4425f76fe816805f19e91db58b9a6d89d7d.png"]
New Modifier: Shard Swap
Enable Shard Swap in the stage selection to switch characters during a match!
Newly acquired squad members now become your Main Shard. The previous leader becomes a Support Shard.
Dynamically switch between shards during the match to discover new types of strategy and team building!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45317685/07afe5d6d721f926476fae83e4fa3124710b1197.gif"]
New Mode: Echoes of Omen
Complete the main story to unlock the new mode.
Talk to Edgar at the base to face a marathon of all 8 story mode stages in sequence.
Complete the mode to unlock higher omen levels and get better rewards!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45317685/cc746159c14a7f4fa695317c176e79e7b8e60c80.gif"]
New Mechanic: Dodge
All damage received has a chance to be negated with a dodge!
"Ninja" and "Ghostly" Power Ups now increase dodge chance.
New Recipes
Blue Ice Cream: increases Ice element damage
Hot Dodge: increases dodge chances when taking damage
Birthday Cake: increases the number of relics that can be equipped
Margherita Pizza: increases Support shard damage
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45317685/15dfd345cc70397c81d69568a4c03a671acad1f5.png"]
Dash Charges
You now have two Dash charges that recharge in sequence.
Base character speed and speed effects have also been improved, allowing more control over your character!
Rework of the "Protector" trait
In addition to increasing Max Health, "Protector" now also increases the Area of Effect attribute based on the Shard's max health.
The effect scales with any other improvements that increase your shard's max health.
General adjustments
The companion created by the "Carp Pendant" relic had its skill revised to better reflect the Water element.
General damage and effect scaling improvement across all relics in the game!
Added new "Drill" Upgrade
Bug fixes
And that's not all! Get ready for a new adventure in Mellunia…
Shard Squad: Onyx Rising is a roguelike auto-battler where you'll be able to use your favorite shards in a new story in the Shard Squad universe!
Wishlist and follow it now to receive news about this new project!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45317685/bec2a1d5d505b8bf38aaccac68948ffc8492ac75.png"]
New Mechanic: Special Items
A new type of collectable now appears during stages!
Collect a Special Item to activate a powerful random effect!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45317685/64404abaf6d1d01e7788feaf86c2c1199a280308.gif"]
New Upgrade: Ring of Power
Purchase a Ring of Power on the upgrade selection to boost your damage on all of your effects during a match!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45317685/b416eead855fdd80075b40d1d9753d1486104efc.png"]
Additional experience for defeating bosses
Taking down bosses now creates a circular burst of experience!
The faster you defeat a boss, the more experience is generated!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45317685/80cdd6ed45d7e920d0c5decd4493215cf7fc536a.gif"]
Update: Rerolls
Rerolls are now more likely to show new items whenever they are used.
New mechanics for speedrunning
Defeating bosses and completing events quickly now slightly reduces the time between enemy waves, allowing for even faster stage clears!
Update: Collectables System
Two new types of items now can be dropped from enemies: Mini-Magnet (boosts collect area and speed for a few seconds) and Lucky Dice (+3 rerolls).
All types of collectibles are now more frequent and consistent.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45317685/46d027d961df3e4bcf817202aedea6f4c94d009c.gif"]
Update: Auto-Healing
Auto-healing base value raised from 0 to 1.
Values progression has been adjusted to better match stage difficulty scaling.
Smoothed out difficulty spikes across all stages.
Adjusted the calculation for the “Crystal Shield” upgrade to improve its effectiveness.
And here’s a spoiler for the next BIG update to come! What could it be?
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45317685/f4dc472cc6996a3e106019de619667440a89ba65.png"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45317685/68061c55a6918cc90f6d0bb5c7b5be369373c61d.gif"]
Appears 3 times per match.
If you destroy it before it disappears, you get the chance to choose a buff for the run.
There are over 30 different buffs available, making runs even more strategic.
Experience Boost – level up your Shards faster.
General Damage Boost – increases overall damage dealt to enemies.
Prismatic Damage Boost – amplifies prismatic damage and unleashes colorful destruction.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45317685/da76669bcba0eccd7801fa67abf884c0a672ed9a.gif"]
Apollo – a specialist in long-range attacks.
Lance – a melee fighter who performs claw combos followed by a powerful leap finisher.
Collect clues during the run to activate giant hammers that deal area damage.
The synergy evolves the more it is used, increasing the number of hammer strikes each time it activates.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45317685/d30604dd6ad9c16d34b96fedc53a307d0eae1254.png"]
Momojima Retreat – the return of a legendary boss, now in its PRIME form.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45317685/d43db9ac191864f1b0296b4fa7d7915eef48a491.png"]

notes.title: The Coliseum of Nyr – a completely random stage

items.text: Enemies, bosses, and events change every run
Double boss battles
Some Shards from your squad will fight against you
Defeating Shards drops Sidolfus Amulets, allowing you to choose random relics during the run (up to 5), enabling combinations never seen before.
At the end, face the Coliseum Champion to prove your worth.
We reworked and improved several traits. Some of them didn’t feel impactful enough before.
Fire Trait: damage now increases per level and its effect can stack multiple times on the same target.
Water Trait: now summons a rain cloud that deals area damage over time.
Electric Trait: now deals more damage and triggers more consistently.
Crystal Trait: damage increased and the vortex now follows targets.
Beaked Trait: effect changed to increase damage against Bosses.
Hunter Trait: now deals more damage and triggers more consistently.
Stage adjustments to improve the difficulty curve
Increased overall money gain
Buffs to several Shards, recipes, and upgrades
Improvements to multiple relics
You can now earn extra bixies when playing with selected Shards
Next week, carried by distant winds, our first DLC arrives bringing the long-awaited Wind Shards!
The achievement for collecting the maximum number of bixies has been removed.

topNew: If you destroy it before it disappears, you get the chance to choose a buff for the run.

items.text: Our beloved nature capybara is doing very well, but we felt he needed a little boost in the early levels! Boost delivered!
New skill for the Nature synergy!

We felt the Nature synergy was falling behind the other elemental synergies, so we rebuilt its skill! Now, instead of summoning a plant that shoots projectiles, you will summon a plant that deals area damage with a chance to poison!
From now on, you will also be able to adjust the transparency level of support shards and helpers summoned by relics or synergies!
For better clarity regarding Movement Speed and Collection Range upgrades, we’ve changed the scale used to display their values.

notes.title: New visual when activating or evolving squad synergies

items.text: Whenever you activate or evolve one of your squad’s synergies, a visual effect will highlight the transition!

notes.title: New recipe on Chef Jokan’s menu

items.text: Dash Cooldown Reduction (Açaí): a highly anticipated recipe! Now you’ll be able to make the interval between your dashes shorter and shorter!

notes.title: Improvements to several recipes on Chef Jokan’s menu

items.text: We’ve enhanced the efficiency of several of our recipes. Now you can become even stronger!

notes.title: Kashmyr Archipelago and Nimbus Forest balanced

items.text: We slightly eased the difficulty of the first two stages to provide a better early-game experience!
Greater clarity in some information on the stage selection menu:
We added a marker for unique events completed per stage and a field to make it easier to identify the difficulty level.

notes.title: New rules for accessing Hard Mode (Hero)

items.text: Hard mode will no longer be available at the start of the game (unless you’ve already completed a stage in it). It will now only be unlocked after finishing the main story.
We’ve added a new tab (System) to the menu options, featuring new functionalities:
Skip event freeze: allows you to automatically skip the tutorial pause for events you’ve already completed (we recommend enabling this option if you’re already familiar with the game’s events);
Change mouse cursor: we’ve added several cursor options! You can choose whichever works best to keep it from getting lost on the screen;
Return to title screen: you can now go back to the title screen before the menu!
In the Sound tab of the menu, you will also be able to change the sound effect played when collecting experience!
Playing with a controller hides the mouse cursor after a short time.
We’ve added a new resolution: 4K!

We’ve enhanced the efficiency of several of our recipes. Now you can become even stronger!
We’ve added a new tab (System) to the menu options, featuring new functionalities:

items.text: In some cases, the number of projectiles was not increasing as it should. Fortunately, we’ve already solved the issue!

notes.title: Fix for the extremely rare cases of save issues

items.text: We resolved a bug that, on rare occasions, would fail to save the player's progress.
Interaction between the Champion’s Trophy relic and the Canned Spinach reward:
Fixed a bug that caused a strange interaction between the Champion’s Trophy relic and the Canned Spinach reward!
See you in the next update, and happy adventuring!
Value information when upgrading shards or items during a match:
From now on, whenever you upgrade your leader during a match, you’ll be able to see exactly which attributes each improvement will affect in your stats or abilities!

notes.title: Statistics when pausing the game during a match

items.text: For those who enjoy numbers and analyzing their upgrade stats, we’ve added a table with all the numerical information that influences your match! You can view this table by pausing the game during the match.

Now, when starting Shard Squad for the first time, you’ll be able to choose between Apprentice and Explorer difficulties! We also added one more card to the initial tutorial to better explain how difficulty selection works before starting a match. If you prefer a more relaxing experience with Shard Squad, we recommend starting in Apprentice mode. If you’re looking for the game’s intended challenge, face the Explorer mode! Regardless of your choice, it can be changed at any time afterward.
We fixed an issue with the dash interactions of some flying enemies and the stage boundaries.
Changes to the descriptions of Hourglass, Lucky Clover, and Scale Catalyst:
We updated the descriptions of the Hourglass, Lucky Clover, and Scale Catalyst items to make it clear that choosing any of them during a match applies the improvement to your entire squad!
Bug when changing difficulty after pressing the “Play” button:
We noticed that after pressing “Play” to start a match, it was still possible to change the difficulty during the brief transition from the menu to the gameplay. Bug fixed!
We adjusted the Bixie multipliers for the Apprentice and Hero difficulties!

notes.title: Liu Kong’s riddle updated in English

items.text: There were some inaccuracies in the riddles for the mission to unlock the prismatic shard Liu Kong in English. We updated the descriptions and hope more players will be able to find him and enjoy the second prismatic shard!
We fixed the bug that allowed players to use dash after being defeated.

[p align="justify"]We’re immensely grateful to everyone who ventured into this first week of Shard Squad! We’re paying close attention to the feedback, and we truly appreciate all the love from the community!
And to give you a little taste of what’s coming in the future, here’s a spoiler of an upcoming update we’re working on for you:

See you in the next update, and enjoy your adventures!
